evals.expected_output: A todo_list block example in both JSON (with type 'todo_list', data containing delta and checked) and Dart (todoListNode(checked: ..., text: ...)).

evals.prompt: I need a sample Novident document that has a heading, a bulleted list with two items, and a 2x2 table. Give me the full JSON and the Dart code to build it.
